title: Robust SSE backpressure recovery and JSON-boundary resynchronization under chunking
author: Aisha Khatri
release_notes: Fixes rare stream desyncs caused by backpressure-induced fragmentation: improves SSE parser resynchronization, adds a fast-path for delimiter-prefixed fragments, stashes and reorders sentinel tokens during retransmit to preserve function-call ordering. No API changes.
description: Motivation: Under high client backpressure and aggressive batching we observed a class of desynchronization issues where partial JSON payloads lost delimiter context or retransmitted fragments interleaved function-call sentinels, causing OpenAI-compatible SDKs to fail to reconstruct structured output or to apply function calls out of order. Summary: Introduces a lightweight resynchronization protocol and parser hardening without changing the public API: 1) add a small fragment header with a 8-bit rolling window checksum and frag_seq per request so receivers can detect gaps quickly and trigger resync; 2) emit an opt-in resync_marker SSE event from the server when sequence gaps or overlap are detected to allow clients to fast-resynchronize state; 3) parser: delimiter-aware coalescing with a bounded lookback and a quoted-boundary heuristic to avoid treating delimiter bytes inside JSON strings or escapes as stream boundaries; 4) retransmit/replay path: stash in-flight sentinel tokens (function-call sentinels, tool markers) and enforce stable replay ordering on retransmit to avoid interleaving; 5) OpenAI-compat adapter: expose an opt-in "resync" mode so SDKs can opt into marker-aware reconstruction during staged rollout. Tests: deterministic backpressure simulator, randomized fuzz harness against the SSE parser (500k runs), targeted integration tests ensuring function-call ordering across retransmits, and a small perf bench to quantify cost. Rollout: staged canary at 5% then 25% with monitoring for resync_marker emission rate and tail latency; rollback criteria documented. Related work: builds on ENG-2419 and addresses customer incident SUP-9876. No breaking API changes and SDKs can opt-in. Detailed commit history, changed areas, reviewer discussion, and CI results follow.
commits_summary: 7 commits: add fragment header and checksum; implement resync_marker emission; delimiter-aware coalescer and quoted-boundary heuristic; stash-and-reorder replay path for sentinel tokens; OpenAI adapter opt-in flag; add backpressure simulator and fuzz tests; docs and test flake fixes.
files_changed: sse/parser.go (core parser + checksum/frag_seq), sse/reassembly_test.go (fuzz harness + deterministic cases), sse/backpressure_sim.go (simulator harness), openai/compat/stream_adapter.go (resync opt-in and marker handling), docs/sse.md (protocol notes + rollout guidance), sdk/ts/streaming.ts (compat shim and opt-in example)
review_comments: Julian Meyers: Overall approach looks good — can you quantify the perf cost of the header/checksum in the common case? Please add a microbenchmark and document the cost in docs/sse.md.
Aisha Khatri: Added microbenchmark in sse/bench_checksum.go and included results in docs; median token latency regression under synthetic backpressure was 0.4% at canary settings.
Chen Li: The quoted-boundary heuristic looks fragile on nested escapes. Please add a unit test that fuzzes nested string escapes and confirm no false boundaries.
Aisha Khatri: Added nested-escape fuzz test and extended fuzz corpus; CI fuzz pass included in results.
Sofia Morales: Needed a TTL on stashed sentinel tokens to avoid unbounded memory during extreme retransmit storms. Please add a soft TTL and metrics for dropped stashed tokens.
Aisha Khatri: Implemented 30s soft TTL and exported metrics sse.stash.dropped_ttl and sse.resync_marker.count; added test and docs.
Julian Meyers: Approving pending documentation updates and CI green. Thanks for the thorough tests.
ci_details: CI summary: linux/amd64 unit tests passed, initial integration run had 1 intermittent failure in streaming_e2e (rerun succeeded), fuzz harness run completed (500k iterations) with no parser regressions, coverage: sse module 82%, perf bench indicates 0.4% median latency regression under heavy backpressure and negligible throughput impact. Flaky test fixes included in last commit.
tests_run: sse/reassembly_test.go - deterministic cases and nested-escape fuzz
integration/streaming_e2e - simulated client backpressure and retransmit scenarios
compat/openai_stream_test.ts - validator for function-call ordering and resync_marker handling
merge_outcome_note: Merged after reviewers approved and CI green; rolled to canary with monitored metrics. No rollback required during canary.
notes_for_ops: When enabling resync mode for SDKs, watch sse.resync_marker.count and sse.stash.dropped_ttl; default off for older SDKs. If >0.05% of requests emit resync_marker in steady-state, investigate upstream batching/backpressure settings.
changelog_entry: fix(sse): add resynchronization protocol and parser hardening to prevent partial-JSON and delimiter loss under backpressure; opt-in OpenAI-compat resync mode; no public API change
